title: Seq2SQL: Generating Structured Queries from Natural Language using Reinforcement Learning
reported_accuracy_metric: WikiSQL EX 59.4% (original Seq2SQL)
primary_failure_mode: No JOIN; aggregation limited to one table
use_when: One flat table, simple filters, no enterprise schema.
avoid_when: Multi-table joins, metric definitions, or document evidence.
key_innovation: Early neural semantic parser that maps a question to a SQL sketch over a single Wikipedia table.

title: Spider: A Large-Scale Human-Labeled Dataset for Complex and Cross-Domain Semantic Parsing and Text-to-SQL Task
reported_accuracy_metric: Dataset paper; later LLM EX ~86-91% on Spider 1.0
primary_failure_mode: Cross-domain schema generalization; JOIN key errors
use_when: Need a public cross-domain SQL benchmark with gold queries.
avoid_when: Treating Spider 1.0 scores as enterprise readiness.
key_innovation: Cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark that forced models to generalize to unseen databases.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
reported_accuracy_metric: NQ top-20 passage recall 79.4%
primary_failure_mode: Misses lexical-exact matches that BM25 catches
use_when: Open-domain passage search over a large text corpus.
avoid_when: Exact aggregates, joins, or row-level security.
key_innovation: Showed that learned dense retrievers can outperform BM25 for open-domain QA.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
reported_accuracy_metric: NQ EM 44.5% (RAG-Token)
primary_failure_mode: Hallucinated span when retrieved docs are weak
use_when: Factoid QA over Wikipedia-style text.
avoid_when: Need a guaranteed numeric aggregate from a warehouse.
key_innovation: Named the RAG recipe: parametric generator conditioned on non-parametric retrieved memory.

title: HybridQA: A Dataset of Multi-Hop Question Answering over Tabular and Textual Data
reported_accuracy_metric: HYBRIDER ~44% EM on test (early baseline)
primary_failure_mode: Broken table-to-passage hops
use_when: Answer needs a Wikipedia table plus linked prose.
avoid_when: Production warehouses with RLS and official metrics.
key_innovation: First large benchmark that requires hopping between tables and linked text.

title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
reported_accuracy_metric: NQ EM 51.4% (FiD-large)
primary_failure_mode: Lost evidence when many passages disagree
use_when: Need to fuse many retrieved passages into one answer.
avoid_when: SQL-style exact group-by over typed columns.
key_innovation: Encodes retrieved passages independently and fuses them in the decoder.

title: Open Question Answering over Tables and Text
reported_accuracy_metric: Early BM25-HYBRIDER ~10% EM (retrieval-hard setting)
primary_failure_mode: Table retrieval failure in open corpus
use_when: Table and text evidence are not given; must retrieve both.
avoid_when: A known schema already answers the question with SQL.
key_innovation: Decontextualized HybridQA into an open retrieval setting over tables and text.

title: PICARD: Parsing Incrementally for Constrained Auto-Regressive Decoding from Language Models
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 79.3% (T5-3B + PICARD, reported era SOTA)
primary_failure_mode: Valid SQL that is still the wrong query
use_when: Need guaranteed parseable SQL from a generator.
avoid_when: The hard part is schema/business meaning, not syntax.
key_innovation: Rejects illegal tokens at decode time so the model can only emit valid SQL.

title: TAT-QA: A Question Answering Benchmark on a Hybrid of Tabular and Textual Content in Finance
reported_accuracy_metric: TAGOP ~55-70% EM depending on split/era; later TAT-LLM 81.4%
primary_failure_mode: Wrong arithmetic scale (million vs percent)
use_when: Financial questions that mix a table and surrounding narrative.
avoid_when: Warehouse queries with official metric SQL.
key_innovation: Finance QA that requires both table cells and paragraph evidence plus arithmetic.

title: FinQA: A Dataset of Numerical Reasoning over Financial Data
reported_accuracy_metric: FinQANet ~61% program accuracy (original); expert 91%
primary_failure_mode: Wrong DSL op order; missed table row
use_when: Need a checkable numeric program over earnings tables and text.
avoid_when: Free-form policy questions with no executable program.
key_innovation: Annotates financial questions with executable reasoning programs, not just spans.

title: RESDSQL: Decoupling Schema Linking and Skeleton Parsing for Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 79.9% (RESDSQL-3B)
primary_failure_mode: Schema mis-link on similarly named columns
use_when: Fine-tuned SQL models where schema linking is the bottleneck.
avoid_when: Need document-grounded metric definitions.
key_innovation: Splits schema linking from SQL skeleton generation to cut cross-talk.

title: C3: Zero-shot Text-to-SQL with ChatGPT
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 82.3% (ChatGPT, zero-shot era)
primary_failure_mode: Prompt-sensitive schema mistakes
use_when: Zero-shot SQL with a strong chat model and a moderate schema.
avoid_when: Spider 2.0 / warehouse workflows.
key_innovation: Showed careful prompting, calibration, and consistency can make ChatGPT competitive on Spider.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
reported_accuracy_metric: U-shaped position curve; middle-context accuracy drops sharply
primary_failure_mode: Lost-in-the-middle; ignored middle chunks
use_when: Diagnosing why a RAG stack ignores the right chunk.
avoid_when: Using long-context dump as a substitute for retrieval ranking.
key_innovation: Measured that models use the start and end of a long context far better than the middle.

title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Gains over single-shot RAG on multi-hop and long-form sets
primary_failure_mode: Extra retrieval loops when confidence is poorly calibrated
use_when: Generation should pull more docs only when it starts to guess.
avoid_when: A single executable SQL already answers the question.
key_innovation: Retrieves again during generation when next-token confidence drops (FLARE).

title: DIN-SQL: Decomposed In-Context Learning of Text-to-SQL with Self-Correction
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider test EX 85.3%; BIRD test EX 55.9%
primary_failure_mode: Wrong JOIN after a bad sub-task; empty execution
use_when: Complex SQL that benefits from decompose-then-fix.
avoid_when: Need private document grounding; DIN-SQL ignores long enterprise docs.
key_innovation: Breaks text-to-SQL into schema linking, classification, generation, and self-correction.

title: Can LLM Already Serve as A Database Interface? A BIg Bench for Large-Scale Database Grounded Text-to-SQLs
reported_accuracy_metric: GPT-4 EX 54.9% test; human 92.96%; VES reported
primary_failure_mode: Missed external knowledge; inefficient plans
use_when: SQL over messy real DBs that need a short evidence hint.
avoid_when: Assuming BIRD EX is warehouse performance (see BEAVER, Spider 2.0).
key_innovation: Large-scale text-to-SQL bench with dirty values, external knowledge, and efficiency (VES).

title: Text-to-SQL Empowered by Large Language Models: A Benchmark Evaluation
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 86.6% (DAIL-SQL + GPT-4); BIRD ~57.4% in follow-up tables
primary_failure_mode: Bad few-shot example selection
use_when: Prompted SQL where similar labeled queries help.
avoid_when: No labeled SQL neighborhood; or document-only questions.
key_innovation: Systematic LLM text-to-SQL study and a question/SQL-aware demonstration picker (DAIL-SQL).

title: MAC-SQL: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: BIRD test EX 59.59% (MAC-SQL + GPT-4)
primary_failure_mode: Selector drops the needed table; refiner loops
use_when: Wide schemas where an agent should first pick tables, then write SQL.
avoid_when: A narrative question with no executable tables.
key_innovation: Multi-agent SQL pipeline with explicit selection, decomposition, and refinement.

title: CodeS: Towards Building Open-source Language Models for Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: BIRD EX ~59% (CodeS-15B, reported leaderboard era)
primary_failure_mode: Schema filter misses a join table
use_when: Need an open SQL specialist model instead of a closed API.
avoid_when: Unstructured PDF QA.
key_innovation: Open incremental-pretraining recipe for text-to-SQL models (CodeS).

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
reported_accuracy_metric: Beats Llama2-chat+RAG on QA and citation accuracy (7B/13B)
primary_failure_mode: Reflection tokens skip needed retrieval
use_when: Not every question should retrieve; want critique of passages.
avoid_when: Typed warehouse metrics that SQL should compute.
key_innovation: Trains a model to decide whether to retrieve and to critique its own evidence.

title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Consistent gains over naive RAG when first-pass retrieval is wrong
primary_failure_mode: Evaluator confidence errors; noisy web fallback
use_when: Internal search is often wrong and you can escalate (web or second index).
avoid_when: Air-gapped SQL with no second corpus.
key_innovation: Scores retrieved docs and triggers correct / incorrect / ambiguous actions before generating.

title: CRAG -- Comprehensive RAG Benchmark
reported_accuracy_metric: Naive RAG 44%; industry RAG ~63% hallucination-free
primary_failure_mode: Hallucination on dynamic, long-tail, or complex facts
use_when: Evaluating factual RAG, not SQL EX.
avoid_when: Using CRAG scores as warehouse SQL performance.
key_innovation: RAG bench with dynamism, popularity, and mock search/KG APIs (KDD Cup 2024).

title: From Local to Global: A GraphRAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
retrieval_mechanism: Entity graph + Leiden communities + hierarchical summaries
reported_accuracy_metric: Higher comprehensiveness/diversity vs naive RAG on global questions
primary_failure_mode: Index cost; graph construction errors; weak on exact counts
use_when: Corpus-level themes: 'what are the main risks in these filings?'
avoid_when: SUM/COUNT over facts that live in a database.
key_innovation: Builds an entity graph and community summaries so RAG can answer global questions.

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
reported_accuracy_metric: Strong multi-hop gains vs RAG baselines (paper tables)
primary_failure_mode: Graph incompleteness; entity linking errors
use_when: Multi-hop facts across many docs (who-did-what-where).
avoid_when: Typed revenue aggregates already in SQL.
key_innovation: Uses a hippocampal-inspired KG and PageRank to do multi-hop retrieval without extra LLM hops.

title: CHESS: Contextual Harnessing for Efficient SQL Synthesis
reported_accuracy_metric: BIRD test EX 66.69%; Spider test EX 87.2%
primary_failure_mode: Dropped context node; still fails on Spider 2.0 (~4% lite in later work)
use_when: SQL generation that must retrieve schema docs and examples first.
avoid_when: Pure narrative summarization with no executable query.
key_innovation: Treats schema descriptions and DB context as retrieved evidence for SQL synthesis.

title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Framework; not a single EX number
primary_failure_mode: LLM-as-judge bias; not a substitute for SQL EX
use_when: Scoring a document RAG pipeline without gold SQL.
avoid_when: Reporting RAGAS as comparable to BIRD EX.
key_innovation: Reference-free RAG scores: faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall.

title: BEAVER: An Enterprise Benchmark for Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: Off-the-shelf LLMs far below Spider/BIRD (paper: poor EX even with RAG)
primary_failure_mode: Hidden domain knowledge; ugly names; deep CTEs
use_when: Arguing that public SQL benches overstate enterprise readiness.
avoid_when: Training only on Spider and claiming production.
key_innovation: Real private warehouse queries with labels for joins, columns, and domain knowledge.

title: Spider 2.0: Evaluating Language Models on Real-World Enterprise Text-to-SQL Workflows
retrieval_mechanism: Metadata, dialect docs, and codebase search
reported_accuracy_metric: o1-preview agent 21.3% vs 91.2% Spider 1.0 / 73% BIRD (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Long-context workflow; dialect; multi-query plans
security_privacy_support: Cloud warehouse settings (BigQuery/Snowflake), not RLS eval
use_when: Enterprise SQL that needs docs and project code, not just a schema dump.
avoid_when: Citing Spider 1.0 90% as the enterprise number.
key_innovation: 632 real warehouse workflows; models must search docs/code and emit long SQL.

title: T2-RAGBench: Text-and-Table Benchmark for Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation
retrieval_mechanism: BM25 + dense over finance text-and-table docs
reported_accuracy_metric: Retrieval+QA; context-independent questions (~23k)
primary_failure_mode: Retriever misses the right report; numeric QA after a miss
use_when: Comparing retrieval quality on financial tables+text, not oracle context.
avoid_when: A live warehouse already stores the same facts as typed columns.
key_innovation: Turns oracle table-text QA into a retrieval benchmark with standalone questions.

title: EntSQL: A Benchmark for Grounding Text-to-SQL in Long-Context Enterprise Knowledge
reported_accuracy_metric: Best English EX 15.9% with long documents
primary_failure_mode: Failed evidence extraction from private policy/metric docs
security_privacy_support: Private business documents (no public RLS test)
use_when: The SQL is easy only after reading internal metric/policy docs.
avoid_when: Schema-only questions with no hidden business rules.
key_innovation: Bilingual enterprise text-to-SQL where the gold query depends on long private documents.

title: SQLNet: Generating Structured Queries From Natural Language Without Reinforcement Learning
reported_accuracy_metric: WikiSQL EX 68.0% (test, original report)
primary_failure_mode: No JOIN; sketch cannot capture multi-table grain
use_when: Single-table WikiSQL-style filters without RL training.
avoid_when: Cross-domain multi-table SQL.
key_innovation: Replaced Seq2SQL reinforcement learning with a query sketch and sequential-set prediction.

title: Towards Complex and Cross-domain Text-to-SQL in Natural Language with Intermediate Representation
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 54.7% with BERT (original IRNet)
primary_failure_mode: Intermediate representation misses nested SQL
use_when: Need a grammar-backed parser on Spider-style joins.
avoid_when: Prompted LLM SQL on warehouse dialects.
key_innovation: Maps questions to SemQL, then deterministically to SQL, for cross-domain Spider.

title: SParC: Cross-Domain Semantic Parsing in Context
reported_accuracy_metric: Dataset paper; question match far below Spider single-turn
primary_failure_mode: Dropped context from earlier turns
use_when: Follow-up SQL questions that refer to a previous query.
avoid_when: Treating it as a document-chat benchmark.
key_innovation: Cross-domain conversational text-to-SQL with context-dependent queries.

title: CoSQL: A Conversational Text-to-SQL Challenge Towards Cross-Domain Natural Language Interfaces to Databases
reported_accuracy_metric: Dataset paper; includes unanswerable and clarification turns
primary_failure_mode: Wrong dialogue act; SQL after a clarification miss
use_when: SQL chat that must refuse or ask a clarifying question.
avoid_when: One-shot warehouse KPI lookup.
key_innovation: DB-grounded dialogue with SQL, response generation, and unanswerable turns.

title: RAT-SQL: Relation-Aware Schema Encoding and Linking for Text-to-SQL Parsers
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 69.7% with BERT (test)
primary_failure_mode: Schema-link errors on similarly named columns
use_when: Fine-tuned parsers that must encode foreign keys explicitly.
avoid_when: Closed-book prompting with no schema graph.
key_innovation: Relation-aware self-attention that treats schema links as first-class edges.

title: TaBERT: Pretraining for Joint Understanding of Textual and Tabular Data
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 65.2% with RAT-SQL+TaBERT (original)
primary_failure_mode: Sampled cell values miss the linking cue
use_when: Column names are opaque and cell values help linking.
avoid_when: PII in cells cannot be shown to the encoder.
key_innovation: Pretrains a joint text-table encoder on sampled rows to help schema linking.

title: Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-SQL with Distilled Test Suites
reported_accuracy_metric: Test-suite accuracy; stricter than single-DB EX
primary_failure_mode: EX agrees on one instance but the query is semantically wrong
use_when: Need a harder SQL metric than one-database execution.
avoid_when: Using it as a RAG faithfulness score.
key_innovation: Distills extra database instances so execution tests semantic equivalence more tightly.

title: GraPPa: Grammar-Augmented Pre-Training for Table Semantic Parsing
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 73.4% (original GraPPa report with RAT-SQL)
primary_failure_mode: Still weak on nested SQL and unseen DB names
use_when: Pretraining a SQL parser on synthetic grammar-table pairs.
avoid_when: Warehouse workflows with dialect files.
key_innovation: Pretrains table-text models on SQL-grammar synthetic data.

title: SmBoP: Semi-autoregressive Bottom-up Semantic Parsing
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 69.5% (SmBoP + GraPPa era)
primary_failure_mode: Beam search misses a join subtree
use_when: Need a non-left-to-right SQL decoder.
avoid_when: Few-shot GPT-style prompting.
key_innovation: Decodes SQL trees bottom-up in parallel rather than token by token.

title: Natural SQL: Making SQL Easier to Infer from Natural Language Specifications
retrieval_mechanism: NatSQL intermediate then compile to SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EM 73.7% with RAT-SQL+NatSQL (reported)
primary_failure_mode: NatSQL compile error on GROUP BY grain
use_when: Want a simpler IR than full SQL for a neural parser.
avoid_when: Need the model to emit dialect SQL directly.
key_innovation: Removes FROM/JOIN clutter from the target so parsers predict a simpler IR.

title: KaggleDBQA: Realistic Evaluation of Text-to-SQL Parsers
retrieval_mechanism: Schema linking on messy Kaggle DBs
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider-trained parsers drop sharply (paper: often <40% EX)
primary_failure_mode: Ugly names; domain mismatch from Spider
use_when: Need a public SQL set closer to analyst databases than Spider.
avoid_when: Citing only Spider after training on Spider.
key_innovation: Real Kaggle databases with undocumented columns as a realism check.

title: EHRSQL: A Practical Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Electronic Health Records
reported_accuracy_metric: Nested-query heavy; models far below simple Spider items
primary_failure_mode: Time-window nested SQL; unanswerable questions
security_privacy_support: Clinical schema (no live RLS protocol in the bench)
use_when: Healthcare SQL with nested time filters and some unanswerable asks.
avoid_when: Open-domain Wikipedia RAG.
key_innovation: MIMIC-derived questions with nested SQL and explicit unanswerable cases.

title: Graphix-T5: Mixing Pre-Trained Transformers with Graph-Aware Layers for Text-to-SQL Parsing
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 80.5% with PICARD (Graphix-T5-3B era)
primary_failure_mode: Graph layers still miss rare join paths
use_when: Fine-tuned T5 SQL with explicit schema graphs.
avoid_when: Multi-file warehouse jobs.
key_innovation: Inserts graph-aware layers into T5 so foreign-key structure is encoded.

title: Dr.Spider: A Diagnostic Evaluation Benchmark towards Text-to-SQL Robustness
reported_accuracy_metric: Large drops vs Spider when names/questions are perturbed
primary_failure_mode: Brittleness to synonym and schema perturbation
use_when: Stress-testing a SQL parser beyond the original Spider split.
avoid_when: Reporting only unperturbed Spider EX.
key_innovation: 17 perturbation sets that break models that look strong on Spider.

title: SQL-PaLM: Improved Large Language Model Adaptation for Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: Spider EX 77.3% few-shot PaLM-2; higher with fine-tune (paper tables)
primary_failure_mode: Prompt brittleness; schema overflow
use_when: Adapting a large foundation model to SQL without a specialist stack.
avoid_when: Document-only policy questions.
key_innovation: Systematic few-shot and fine-tune recipe for PaLM on text-to-SQL.

title: MCS-SQL: Leveraging Multiple Prompts and Multiple-Choice Selection For Text-to-SQL Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: BIRD test EX 65.45%; BIRD dev 63.36% (MCS-SQL + GPT-4)
primary_failure_mode: All candidates share the same join bug
use_when: Can afford several SQL samples and pick by execution.
avoid_when: Hard p95 latency budgets.
key_innovation: Samples diverse SQL with multiple prompts and selects with execution checks.

title: CHASE-SQL: Multi-Path Reasoning and Preference Optimized Candidate Selection in Text-to-SQL
reported_accuracy_metric: BIRD test EX 73.0% with Gemini 1.5 (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Ranker prefers fluent but wrong SQL
use_when: Need a high BIRD-era prompted SQL system with ranking.
avoid_when: Assuming that BIRD 73% is Spider 2.0 performance.
key_innovation: Several reasoning paths for SQL plus a learned selector among candidates.

title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
reported_accuracy_metric: NQ Open EM 40.4% (REALM original)
primary_failure_mode: Retriever index stale relative to the generator
use_when: Pretraining a language model that must retrieve Wikipedia.
avoid_when: Typed warehouse aggregates.
key_innovation: Jointly pretrains a retriever and a language model with a latent document variable.

title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
reported_accuracy_metric: MS MARCO MRR@10 36.0% (original ColBERT)
primary_failure_mode: Index size; still not a numeric executor
use_when: Need finer retrieval than a single vector per passage.
avoid_when: SQL over a star schema.
key_innovation: Late interaction: cheap document encodings with token-level matching at query time.

title: Improving Language Models by Retrieving from Trillions of Tokens
retrieval_mechanism: Chunk retrieval into a retrieval-enhanced transformer
reported_accuracy_metric: Matches larger models on some LM/QA probes with retrieval (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Retrieved chunks can inject noise into next-token prediction
use_when: Want retrieval inside the language-model stack, not only at QA time.
avoid_when: Need an auditable SQL string.
key_innovation: Retrieves trillions of tokens into a transformer (RETRO) during modeling.

title: Unsupervised Dense Information Retrieval with Contrastive Learning
reported_accuracy_metric: Competitive BEIR nDCG without labeled pairs (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Domain shift when the corpus is not web text
use_when: Need a dense retriever without in-domain labeled pairs.
avoid_when: Exact KPI lookup.
key_innovation: MoCo-style contrastive pretraining for a dual-encoder retriever.

title: Atlas: Few-shot Learning with Retrieval Augmented Language Models
reported_accuracy_metric: Strong few-shot KILT/NQ with 64-shot Atlas-large (paper tables)
primary_failure_mode: Retriever-generator co-training cost
use_when: Few-shot knowledge tasks where the retriever can be trained with the generator.
avoid_when: Read-only warehouse SQL.
key_innovation: Jointly trains retriever and Fusion-in-Decoder for few-shot knowledge tasks.

title: In-Context Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
retrieval_mechanism: In-context documents without fine-tuning the LM
reported_accuracy_metric: Perplexity and QA gains from in-context retrieval (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Document order and truncation in the window
use_when: A frozen LM that can read retrieved passages in the prompt.
avoid_when: Need execution accuracy on SQL.
key_innovation: Shows retrieval in the prompt of a frozen LM is enough for many RAG gains.

title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
reported_accuracy_metric: Zero-shot nDCG gains vs using the raw query as the embedding (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Hypothetical doc invents facts the retriever then matches
use_when: Zero-shot dense retrieval when queries are short.
avoid_when: The query is already a precise SQL filter.
key_innovation: Embeds a generated hypothetical answer instead of the raw query.

title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
reported_accuracy_metric: Large multi-hop gains over one-shot retrieve-then-read (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Error in an early thought poisons later retrieves
use_when: Multi-hop questions that need a new retrieve after each step.
avoid_when: A single SQL join already encodes the hops.
key_innovation: Interleaves retrieval with chain-of-thought instead of retrieving once.

title: REPLUG: Retrieval-Augmented Black-Box Language Models
retrieval_mechanism: Ensemble of retrieved docs for a frozen LM
reported_accuracy_metric: NQ/TriviaQA gains for frozen GPT-3-style models (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Cannot update LM weights; bad docs still vote
use_when: The generator is a closed API and only the retriever can be trained.
avoid_when: Need a planner that emits SQL.
key_innovation: Treats retrieval as an ensemble over a black-box language model.

title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
reported_accuracy_metric: Gains on long-document QA vs flat chunk RAG (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Summary tree loses numeric detail
use_when: Long documents where flat chunks miss the theme.
avoid_when: Need an exact SUM from a warehouse.
key_innovation: Builds a tree of recursive summaries and retrieves at multiple levels.

title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
reported_accuracy_metric: Better efficiency/accuracy trade-off than always-multi-hop (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Wrong complexity class; under-retrieves a hard item
use_when: A mixed query stream where some items need no retrieve.
avoid_when: Every question is an RLS-bound aggregate.
key_innovation: Routes RAG strategy by predicted question complexity.

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
retrieval_mechanism: Controlled noise, negative, and counterfactual docs
reported_accuracy_metric: Models remain sensitive to noisy and counterfactual retrieved docs
primary_failure_mode: Noise robustness; refusal to use retrieved evidence
use_when: Need a diagnostic RAG bench, not only NQ EM.
avoid_when: Comparing RGB scores to BIRD EX.
key_innovation: RGB tests noise, negative rejection, counterfactual robustness, and information integration.

title: MultiHop-RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Queries
reported_accuracy_metric: 2556 multi-hop items; standard RAG often misses a hop (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Incomplete hop chain in news evidence
use_when: Evaluating RAG on news-style multi-hop questions.
avoid_when: Warehouse joins that SQL should express.
key_innovation: A retrieval-first multi-hop RAG bench over a news corpus.

title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs
reported_accuracy_metric: Matches or beats specialist rankers then generators (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Ranker still drops a long-tail passage
use_when: One model should both rank context and write the answer.
avoid_when: Need a database to compute the answer.
key_innovation: Fine-tunes an LLM to rank retrieved contexts and generate in one framework.

title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
retrieval_mechanism: Lightweight judges for context and answer quality
reported_accuracy_metric: Judge agreement with human RAG ratings (paper); not EX
primary_failure_mode: Judge bias; not a substitute for execution accuracy
use_when: Need cheaper RAG eval than full human labeling.
avoid_when: Putting ARES next to BIRD EX in one ranking.
key_innovation: Trains lightweight judges to score RAG context and answers.

title: Compositional Semantic Parsing on Semi-Structured Tables
retrieval_mechanism: Logical form over a Wikipedia table
reported_accuracy_metric: Original parser 37.1% accuracy on WTQ test
primary_failure_mode: Compositional ops on messy HTML tables
use_when: Questions over a single semi-structured Wikipedia table.
avoid_when: Multi-table warehouses with RLS.
key_innovation: Introduced WikiTableQuestions, still used as a table-QA stress test.

title: TAPAS: Weakly Supervised Table Parsing via Pre-training
reported_accuracy_metric: WTQ 48.8% (TAPAS original large setting)
primary_failure_mode: Aggregation head errors; no warehouse dialect
use_when: A table is already in the context and SQL is optional.
avoid_when: Need a signed-off warehouse query.
key_innovation: Extends BERT with row and column embeddings to parse tables weakly.

title: TAPEX: Table Pre-training via Learning a Neural SQL Executor
retrieval_mechanism: BART pretraining as a neural SQL executor
reported_accuracy_metric: WikiSQL EX 89.5%; WTQ 59.1% (original TAPEX)
primary_failure_mode: Neural executor is not a real database
use_when: Table QA where pretraining on synthetic SQL execution helps.
avoid_when: Need the actual warehouse engine and RLS.
key_innovation: Pretrains a seq2seq model to execute SQL on tables, then uses it for table QA.

title: Towards Complex Document Understanding By Discrete Reasoning
reported_accuracy_metric: Visual document QA; below oracle TAT-QA text setting
primary_failure_mode: PDF layout; broken table lines
use_when: Finance questions on raw PDF pages, not extracted HTML.
avoid_when: A clean warehouse table already exists.
key_innovation: Moves TAT-QA from given text to discrete reasoning over document images.

title: ConvFinQA: Exploring the Chain of Numerical Reasoning in Conversational Finance Question Answering
reported_accuracy_metric: FinQANet-style models drop vs single-turn FinQA (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Broken reasoning chain across turns
use_when: Follow-up numeric questions on an earnings report.
avoid_when: One-shot SQL with no dialogue.
key_innovation: Turns FinQA into a conversation so the numeric program must use prior turns.

title: MultiHiertt: Numerical Reasoning over Multi Hierarchical Tabular and Textual Data
reported_accuracy_metric: Human 93.99%; models much lower on hierarchical reports (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Missed header hierarchy; wrong unit
use_when: Financial reports with nested tables, not flat grids.
avoid_when: Star-schema SQL with clean dimensions.
key_innovation: A hierarchical table-text numeric reasoning benchmark from financial reports.

title: FeTaQA: Free-form Table Question Answering
reported_accuracy_metric: BLEU/ROUGE table-to-text; not SQL EX
primary_failure_mode: Fluent but unfaithful table summaries
use_when: The table answer must be a sentence, not a cell.
avoid_when: Need a checkable numeric program or SQL.
key_innovation: Free-form answers from Wikipedia tables with highlighted supporting cells.

title: Binding Language Models in Symbolic Languages
retrieval_mechanism: LLM emits SQL/Python with API calls back to the LM
reported_accuracy_metric: WTQ 64.6% with Codex (Binder original)
primary_failure_mode: Wrong API call; unexecutable program
use_when: Table questions that need both SQL and a language-model API.
avoid_when: Air-gapped SQL with no model callbacks.
key_innovation: Lets the model write SQL/Python that can call the LM for fuzzy matches.

title: Large Language Models are Versatile Decomposers: Decompose Evidence and Questions for Table-based Reasoning
retrieval_mechanism: Table evidence decomposition then SQL-like ops
reported_accuracy_metric: WTQ 74.8% with Codex (Dater original tables)
primary_failure_mode: Bad sub-table selection
use_when: A large table must be cut down before reasoning.
avoid_when: The warehouse already has the grain.
key_innovation: Uses an LLM to decompose both the table evidence and the question.

title: StructGPT: A General Framework for Large Language Model to Reason over Structured Data
retrieval_mechanism: Iterative interfaces to tables, DBs, and KGs
reported_accuracy_metric: Gains on table/DB/KG sets with GPT-3.5 interfaces (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Wrong interface call; loops on structured APIs
use_when: The store might be a table, a DB, or a KG and the model must pick an API.
avoid_when: A single trusted SQL view is mandatory.
key_innovation: An invoking-linearizing-generating loop over several structured data types.

title: QA-GNN: Reasoning with Language Models and Knowledge Graphs for Question Answering
retrieval_mechanism: LM + GNN over a retrieved KG subgraph
reported_accuracy_metric: CSQA 76.1% with RoBERTa+QA-GNN (original)
primary_failure_mode: Incomplete subgraph; entity linking miss
use_when: QA that can use an existing commonsense KG.
avoid_when: Warehouse SUM with RLS.
key_innovation: Jointly reasons with a language model and a GNN on a working-graph.

title: Think-on-Graph: Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model on Knowledge Graph
retrieval_mechanism: LLM beam search on a KG
reported_accuracy_metric: Hits@1 gains on KGQA vs retrieve-then-read (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Beam path leaves the relevant subgraph
use_when: Multi-hop KGQA where the model should walk edges.
avoid_when: Typed revenue in a star schema.
key_innovation: Treats the KG as a thinking workspace and explores paths with an LLM.

title: G-Retriever: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Understanding and Question Answering
reported_accuracy_metric: GraphQA accuracy gains vs full-graph prompting (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Steiner tree drops a needed node
use_when: Text-attributed graphs that cannot fit in the context window.
avoid_when: Need SQL over tables, not a graph.
key_innovation: Retrieves a compact subgraph with a Steiner-tree objective before generation.

title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Win rates over naive RAG and GraphRAG on comprehensiveness (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Index still costly; weak numeric fidelity
use_when: Need a cheaper graph index than full GraphRAG communities.
avoid_when: Official warehouse totals.
key_innovation: Dual-level entity/relation retrieval meant to be lighter than community GraphRAG.

title: GRAG: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Gains when irrelevant entities are pruned (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Soft prune removes a needed neighbor
use_when: Retrieved subgraphs are noisy and need pruning.
avoid_when: SQL with a known schema.
key_innovation: Soft-prunes irrelevant entities in a retrieved subgraph before generation.

title: GNN-RAG: Graph Neural Retrieval for Large Language Model Reasoning
retrieval_mechanism: GNN retrieval then LLM reasoning on KGQA
reported_accuracy_metric: KGQA Hits@1 competitive with heavier LLM-walk methods (paper)
primary_failure_mode: GNN retrieval miss on rare relations
use_when: KGQA where a GNN can rank candidate entities first.
avoid_when: Document-only themes with no KG.
key_innovation: Uses a GNN as the retriever for LLM reasoning on knowledge graphs.

title: KAG: Boosting LLMs in Professional Domains via Knowledge Augmented Generation
reported_accuracy_metric: Reported gains vs RAG when expert schemas exist (paper)
primary_failure_mode: Schema construction cost; OpenIE noise
use_when: A professional domain already has a conceptual schema.
avoid_when: Ad-hoc KPI SQL with no KG.
key_innovation: Builds domain knowledge graphs with human schemas rather than raw OpenIE only.

title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
retrieval_mechanism: HippoRAG-style KG with better recognition memory
reported_accuracy_metric: Multi-hop gains vs HippoRAG and LightRAG (paper tables)
primary_failure_mode: Still not a warehouse calculator
use_when: Need associative memory over a growing text corpus.
avoid_when: Row-level SQL totals.
key_innovation: HippoRAG 2: denser KG memory and better factual recall than the 2024 system.
